english: Shit ain't funny guys! Need some help here!
Right over here, I know you can hear me!
Check your sensors I'm with you!
Keep it up and I'll take your arms!
I'm billing you for those parts!
Thanks! I'm callin you the next time I need anything
Thanks! They should make em more like you
No problem, but next time it'll cost ya
Don't mention it, part of the job
Help! Need repair! Slot A into B!
You need me out there! Get me up!
Put me back together you twits!
Screwed up lookin... I'll say that much
All of you need repairs?! Normally I'd be thrilled...
If this happens again I'm mixing up who gets whos legs
Well well well, looks like it's just me again.
Holy shit, I cannot WAIT to do that again!
Never gonna get tired of that...
That's what I like to see baby!
All of that was correct? We got paid for that??
Can't get a rush like that anywhere else.
Roachard! Are you takin a shit?
On repairs! Like I need to say it...
It's just a little thingy to click guys cmon!
Put your backs into it we gotta move this!
It can't be that hard to move.
Pay so low they got us hauling shit!
Come on you babies let's get this moved!
One crack about this and I lug it off a cliff.

Layin it down!
Like I always do...
Thing needs to be knocked down!
Gotta get that thing outta the way!
I got a bullet for everyone! EVERY ONE!
Blast their brains into the dirt!
Get over here! All of you!
My shiny metal ass is NOT a target!
Thank you, I'd hug you if you'd survive it
Hah! You did it! Thank you!
You're welcome, stay on your toes
You're welcome, we'll make it through this
I'm not that heavy! Get me up!
This will be the last time you let me down!
This isn't the end, just hold on!
None of you are alive? Unbelievable.
I could get used to this...
And we got payed for all of that? Excellent!
What a strange time to be alive...
Had I a heart it would be pounding right now.
Roachard, make a noise or something!
We need to fix our machines!
This will work! Whether it wants to or not.
It won't be perfect, but it'll work!
We need to get that turned on!
This is away from home! We must assist!
HUP! I have this in hand!
You will be home soon, do not fear.
That's still in one piece! It needs to be in several!
GR! Was that supposed to hurt?
Help a cowboy out would ya?
You really think you're funny dontcha?
Aim straighter dickhead! We got places to be
Bang-up job on that one, thanks
Get yer ass over here and repair me!
Got eyes on some bad actors...
Got a lively one! Get back!
Well well well, just good ole Wrangler now...
I promise you the spotlight is big enough for all of us, you gotta just stop fallin over...
I do NOT enjoy bein left all by my lonesome!!
Thank you thank you ladies and gentle-folks but we will NOT be doin that again.
I remember they killed a fella for pitchin somethin just like that. Not sure why, that was damn fun.
If I didn't know how to scream before, I certainly do now…
What a time to be alive...
Puttin this damn thing back together!
On repairs! For some damn reason...
This better be how it works!
No good letting this lay around!
Ho now! Let's get you where you need to be.
Building! I better get a bonus for all this elbow work!
The lord was a carpenter, he would cry if he saw what we are buildin.
Need some gunpowder politics on this one!
Gotta get our sights on the objective!
Let's blow it straight to hell!
Shootin our fish in the barrel!
Lay down and die you metal scoundrel!
Let’s give em a grand ole time!
Give em hell! And then some!
AGH! Try it again you punk! Try it again!
Watch your fire- WATCH YOUR FIRE!!
What would I do without you...
No problem, stay safe out there!
I'm down! This actually hurts a TON!
Hold still hold still I'll come grab you all in a second!
What?! All of you? You guuuuuysss...
I look away for one second! ...One!
I'm never getting used to this job...
Woa-ho! Danger aside, that's really cool.
Everyone good...? Not in too many pieces at least?
Another one down guys, really got my steps in too!
We're all back? Haha! We're all back!
Roachard I want to talk to you!
Lots of broken junk around here!
The equipment can't function like this!
Just a little thing to flip guys!
Bit rusty, but I got it!
Well shoot we gotta move this stuff!
It can't be that heavy... Right?
Well I can't just leave it here...
Doin my part with the moving!
Guys we gotta destroy that thing!
Can't progress while that's still up!
Weapons free guys! Let’s kill em!
We need to destroy the gunk!
Got a yeuco bomb! Find an enemy!
Let's melt something with this yeuco!
Don't tell Roachard but I just found an oyster
Come over here guys! I won't bite!
Yeah yeah yeah... Let's all shoot the mushroom lady.
OW! Got that outta your system yet?!
Wow! That was a big help!
Friendly one over here! Put me back together!
Hello! I'm on the floor! It sucks down here!!
Ooh! This one said something really mean!
AH the- the stabby ones are right here!
Just me and the mushrooms again...

Bwahaha! It's time for me to turn EVIL and merge with the fungus...
Haha. Just jokin there guys... please get up.
<color=#DC51FF>It is me… I am alone… Very baaaaad…</color>
That's one for the logbook right there...
<color=#DC51FF>I N C R E D I B L E !</color>
So we really have no oversight huh? Like I think half of that was just stuff Roachard wanted us to do…
A fun little expedition we had there. You guys wouldn't get it but I put down sooo many spores… gosh that was so fun!
Roachard! I know you're hiding from me!
Does this thing come with instructions?!

'You're a scientist, you can fix it!'
Gimme a fuckin break...
We need to flip that thing!
We gotta carry something? Is that right?
Nuts! That stuff… it's gotta go over there…
<color=#DC51FF>There are ITEMS around… We need to MOVE them…</color>
Carrying this thing! Don't mind me…
<color=#DC51FF>mMm... This is mine... I like it...</color>
Wow! There are instructions and everything…
Ooh yup! It's workin! This isn't really that hard…
We gotta mess that thing up.
Need to take that thing down…
Ooh yeah let's break this thing!
Hope no one cared about this one…

Oh? You wanna tell em how you feel? Well go ahea-
<color=#DC51FF>I AM THE BEST MUSHROOM!!</color>
Oh yeah? You're goin in the stew alright!

S-someone’s… Someone’s there?! No! Stay away!
Whatever they’re giving you, it isn’t worth it!

Me…? I’m here… To save me…
I knew I was a fool…but... damn.

Too late.
Make the most of the time you have left, you’ll never get it back…

GAH!
Whatever you did… I’m being pulled free! Keep going!

Oh you pissed it off now!
It’s- GA!- You’re doing it though!
Get me OUT!

HaHAAAaaa!
I’m alive! I didn’t think I would last this long…
I have been trapped in there since my team was attacked, but it seems like a lot of the fungus is still… in here… I don't like that.
But I don’t really have a ride so is my contract up or… what?
Whenever you're ready, there's a terminal in the drop pod to select a mission... You're under contract to do that...
Mission selection is over in the drop pod... Go start clicking some buttons and pulling some levers whenever you're ready.
There's a handy little terminal in the drop pod, use it to select a mission and we can get rollin.
Droppod sequence is underway, get inside and get ready to rumble.
Pod is on its way out. Get your asses inside.
Dropping the pod now, get inside and stay inside.
Good job, you've completed all objectives. Hold recall (<>) to request a drop pod for extraction.
That's all listed tasks done and buried, good work and hold that recall button (<>) when you're ready to bounce.
Another job off the list, great work as usual. Hold your recall switch (<>) when you're ready to call the pod.
There's an obstruction above your position. Find a clear spot to request the drop pod.
Something big above you. If you want a pod, look for clearer skies and signal me again.
Some kinda joke? There's a giant... Just find somewhere open and request the pod again.
Well shit. I'm sending down a repair drone.
That's embarrassing. Don't worry, the drone will get you repaired in no time.
Damn it gang. These repair drones ain't cheap.
You've exhausted the repair budget. Shit. Mission's over, I'll see you back at the ship.
No more budget for repairs gang... I'm sorry but I have to pull you back, you'll get em next time.
That was your last shot gang... Good effort, but I gotta call it here...
The drop pod is leaving whether you're in it or not! Get over there!
Pod's not gonna be there much longer!
Running down the time on the drop pod, don't get left behind now!
I can't keep the pod there for much longer!
Pod's gearing to leave soon! Get on er and don't look back!
It's your asses if this job goes under so STOP SHOOTING EACH OTHER!
Why did I have to get these guys?
If I get an ammo request later because of all this I'm takin it outta your pay.
Cargo pod is inbound to your location.
Yep yep cargo pod is on its way.
Pod's inbound to pull you out, stick with it a little longer and you'll be home free.
Ready to leave? Read you loud and clear, pod's on its way.
Drop pod away! Be seein you rascals soon.
Pod's coming down, make sure you all get in it this time...
Extraction systems all green, take your last looks and get up here.
Bang up job down there team, take your breaks and I'll prep for another go-round.
Welcome back! Ran some good numbers on that one I can't lie.
Hey gang! There was a spider up here but I got it, no need to thank me.
Welcome back, I never get used to how ya'll smell after one of those.

Spinnin a recoooord, on myyyy-
Oh you guys are back!
That one doesn't look too far... Whatever, extra parts on the way.
Spare parts inbound, don't try and put two legs together.
More coming down, secondary assembly required.
Look out this one's H U G E!
Oh that doesn't look so bad... OH! I was zoomed out get ready for a big one!
We've been tasked with salvaging a satellite. You'll need to power the decommissioners, shoot the satellite out of orbit, and strip out its data cores.
There's a satellite in orbit with highly sensitive data that corporate wants secured. Power up the decommissioners and de-orbit the satellite so we can strip it.
There's a little satellite up here somewhere and we gotta harvest it. Get those decomission stations connected, knock er down, and get to grabbin.
Take a node from the end of the current cable and toss it out to extend the line. It can stick to most anything, just make sure not to pitch it too far.
Grab onto the end of the cable and throw out a new node to extend it. Nodes can go most places, but they ain't gonna blast the cable through a wall or nothing.
These power relays are built out of these node thingies. Get a new node from the end of the cable and chuck it, easy peasy.
That node landed too far from the end of the cable.
Too far on that throw, keep em closer together.
I know it's fun to throw em but the line can't connect if they're too far.
There's an obstruction between that node and the cable.
Somethin between those two nodes, find a straight shot.
These nodes are pretty dumb, try and give em a clear view of each other.
The Decommissioner is powered. Take out that satellite.
Decomissionin system hot and ready, ground that bird.
Unsuspecting satellite is ready for re-entry, fire away.
Get inside the satellite and strip its data cores. Look out though - blowing the doors will set off its security alarm, so be prepared for a fight.
Satellite is there for the stripping. Alarms are gonna go nuts though, so keep those guns out.
Strippin time gang, get in there and get the goods. There's an alarm system, I don't know the bypass code, so get ready to fight.
Now bring the data cores over to the launch pad and I'll suck em up!
Bring those cores over to the launch pad and blast em up. I'll take it from there.
Launch pad nearby, get the cores over to it and blast em on up. Ole Roachard's got it from there.
Woah! Almost missed it but we're good.

DAMN! That one flew right by...
I'll just mark it as collected.
That's all of the data cores! You've met quota - time to call in the drop pod and get out of there.
You guys really tore through that satellite. All cores collected and accounted for. Great work!
See I knew you guys would do well with this one. Great job cleanin out that satellite!

Management is concerned about a corpo spy ship that's been spotted in orbit.
Your job is to power up the planetary defense system and take it down.
Got a rogue ship in close orbit to New Atlas and you bet we aren't taking any chances. Blow that sucker off the map and get home in time for dinner.
Fun one today, small portion of the planet's defenses is available and ready to blast an un-ID'd ship to pieces.
Maybe call in those scanners so I can take my break?
Team, I really gotta pee. Can you call in those scanners already?
Use those scanners to locate the gunked up power relays. Clear the gunk, turn on the power, and we'll be good to go.
Scanners should point to the necessary power stations, clean em off and they'll be useful again.
Power stations are all down, follow the signals with those scanners and get em cleared.
That's one relay up and running! Just need a little more juice to power the main event.
Not quite enough power... Should be another station to flip on.
Good work, but this thing is greedy. Find another station and get it activated.
Nice work, Planetary Railgun is inbound. Watch your heads, and get on over to it.
All stations online and connected, Planetary Railgun touching down nearby.
That's enough power! Sending the railgun down now...
No Plascutters for you unfortunately, shoot off the clips to unpack it.
Use your guns to knock those clips away and unpack that sucker.
Get rid of that packaging by knocking off those clips, don't care how you do it just get em off.
The railgun is ready to lock on. Use the terminal to zero-in on our bogey.
Alright, it's set up. Now use that terminal to target the rogue ship.
Great great! Next step is to lock the target on that terminal over there.
Target acquired! I'm sending down some batteries to help the railgun rotate into position. Make sure they don't break.
Locked and loaded! Sending down some batteries to help the thing spin towards it. Keep em all in one piece please.
Dead center gang! Bit far off though... Dropping some extra batteries to help the gun get aligned, don't let em break!
The fungus wants a taste of the railgun - protect it!
Grubbies are ravenous today! Keep em off the railgun so it can finishing firing!
Railgun's got the planet excited, keep our little guests from touching it!
All of the batteries are offline! The railgun can't rotate without them!
Got a fat zero on battery integrity. Repair em and get that thing spinning again!
All batteries destroyed! Not making any progress at this rate!
Railgun is in position. Extending barrels now.
We are so close, just gotta...
Quick, fire it! You need to turn all of its safety keys at once.
One key each gang! Turn em all at once and you're golden.
Grab a key and turn it! Teamwork people cmon!!
Railgun charging up. That ship is toast!
Sit back and watch the fireworks gang, you've earned it.
Railgun's charging! Gonna blow that ship out of the sky!
Erm... there may be some debris from the ship you just destroyed coming your way. I suggest you get out of there as soon as possible.
Uh oh... Not our fault... Maybe all our fault... but there's a lot of debris inbound. Get out before the area is torn to shreds.
Hah! ...Oh that's actually terrible. Tons of space junk are about to rain death on you guys, I advise leaving. Immediately!

Ok team, we've been asked to nab the power cell from a nearby facility. You're gonna need to break through the door, take the power cell, and carry it back to the drop pod. It's one of the older Battery Barry models, so be careful with it.

Y'all remember those power cells the lab coats programmed a bit too much? Gave the little guys feelings? Pretty stupid if you ask me, but they're worth more money than any of us are gonna make, ever. So we gotta rescue one. Get to the facility and bring our little piggybank to safety.

Simple supply run, facility went dark a while ago but its power core didn't. Break in, grab the thing, and haul it on home. It's one of those old Battery Barry models, why the pencil pushers decided to give it sentience is beyond me.
Looks like you're at the facility. I'm sending down a laser turret to help cut through the door's seal.
That door is sealed tighter than most, sending down a laser turret to help you pop it open.
You ever cut cookies? Well this is almost nothing like that. Sending down a laser turret so you can cut through the door's seal.
You're through! Head inside and find the power core. And don't forget your flashlights.
Cracked like a melon, gang. Hop on in and grab it. Flashlights are available if the overheads are out.
Door is no more, great work. Power Core should be straight ahead. You've always got flashlights if you lose your way.
Reading life-sign everywhere it isn't supposed to be... Clear that gunk off the core and prepare for the worst.
Damn it. Looks like gunk got through the seals somehow. Free that core and get it out of there, this isn't feeling good.
Ah rats. Thats a lot of fungus isn't it... Cut through as best you can and get the core out of there. You can bet your ass it won't give it over willingly.
Barry is free! Take him back to the drop pod and I'll get you out of there. Quickly now!
Excellent! Double time that thing back to the drop pod. Our mushy friends ain't letting it go without a fight!
Great, you got Barry out of that thing. Bring him with you and he'll power up the drop pod.
The power core is secured! I'm booting up the drop pod so get yourselves inside!
Barry's safe with us now. Now pile in and get the hell outta there!
Barry is loaded! Get your last looks in and extract as soon as possible!
Uhh guys? What are you doing down there?
You really shouldn't be here. This isn't in the mission parameters.
Fine - you want to screw around down there? I don't care. I'm all cozy here with my Saxitos, go play in the dirt if you want just don't track that shit back here.
Oh shit... There's a lot of activity near you. Be careful.
Finally a dead end. I'm sending the drop pod to get you.
Ok team, this mission is simple: we've got a big ass fungal chain gunking things up all over and you're going to destroy it.
Should be a long vine around there, lotta nodules, yeah there's the one. Pop em to keep it from growing onto any more equipment!
Looks like we got another growth chain, should be able to kill it by popping all those boils. These things have been gunking up everything.
Remember to follow the fungal trails, that gunk won't clear itself!
You better not be dicking around down there, we're on a schedule.
Good work, that's a big knot down! Keep on that trail!
That looked like a big one on the sensor, good stuff.
Wow that one looked THICK, keep at it!
Looks like we've hit the end. Whatever laid that trail is pissed though, watch out!
Gunk mama doesn't seem too happy you popped her little project, give er hell!
So there's the bastard that's been laying these, do what you do best and atomize that thing!
That one's throwin up missiles! Shoot em down or get behind somethin quick!
Missiles in the air! Get your sights on em or hide, they seek like nothin else.
Seeker Hornets!? Watch the skies, those things are deadly. Destroy em if you can, hide if you can't.
Alright gang, we got a BUNCH of unrefined Saxonite that needs to be loaded and escorted over to a rocket. Get to that dispenser thing and we'll go from there.
That delivery machine over there has, quite frankly, an irresponsible amount of unrefined Saxonite. You guys gotta get it off world. Get over there and we'll see what we're dealin with.
Let's see here... Get over to that dispenser, get the Saxonite out, and get it to the rocket... Would be a walk in the park if not for how radioactive that stuff is, so expect some trouble.
Alright make like a monkey and start rolling those things! Land em in the right port and you'll get it loaded.
Don't care how you do it, just get those things into the right chute and we'll be golden.
Alright those barrels should be color coded, and those ports over there have the same colors... Bingo bango just get em in there.
Aaand nice work! Got that one loaded in.
That's the spice! I'll get that one loaded right quick...
Sensors are reading all sortsa colors, whatever side you just tossed that in was definetly incorrect!
Ah! Okay when you do that it makes a terrible noise... Just... Wrong side...
Wrong one? Wrong one! Straighten your act out!
Great great! That's all the barrels, hang tight while I prep the transport...
Sorted and done with, preparing next steps...
Barrels all done, lemme just do some button pushing...
Transport is ready to rumble! Hit that switch on the depot and roll out.
And now... Flip that little lever on there and get that show on the road!
Truck's ready for ya, or at least I hope he is, regardless there's a little thing to flip there for you.
Looks like it's all in the rocket. Get the launch process started and we'll be done before you know it.
Alright everythings loaded... Should be a button, lever, or other unlabled initiation device on there to get it on its way...
Nice work, the next listed step is to start up the rocket... So go do that...
Alright, that thing is loud, and highly irradiated so buckle down and prepare for some trouble.
Wowie! I can feel the rads from here gang, get ready for some company on this one!
Saxonite draws em in like nothin else, and lucky for you guys, you're launching up an assload of the stuff, do the math... And don't die!
Almost up! Just a little longer and I'll send it off!
Doing great so far! Just a little longer and I'll be able to pull you out of there!
I know it's hairy down there but you're almost done! Try and hold out a liiiitle longer...
Ooh! All done, sending it off now, extract when ready.
Oh thank god that's all done... Sending it up, then I'm gonna go throw up, get out of there when you're ready.
Done and done! Great work gang, pull out at your leisure.
Hunk what are you doing? Is your pathing system gunked up again?
What the hell is that truck doing? Hunk? Spin back around ASAP you hear?!

Aaand he's backwards, must be something in the pathing system.
Just don't get him worked up about it and we'll be good...

Oh shit! It just... Did that really just...
Shit. Management is gonna be so pissed...

Ok here's what we'll do. Grab as many chunks of Saxonite as you can, should be a bunch raining down on ya.
Whatever we can get of that shipment is worth it!

Good job turning that one around team. Hang on to some of that Saxonite as a little bonus, from me...
Just don't tell anyone.

Ever.

Hey guys! The distortion is fixed! Must have been something on your end.
Ok team, this one's simple. Kill things till they're dead.
Allllright, we got simple weed whacking duty today. Get to killing and thin the population a bit.
Fungal density in this area has gone a bit over the little red "kill" line and it's your job to bring it back doowwwwn.
You're making short work of these guys. Half way there!
Look at that! Halfway through, I don't know why I was even worried, you guys are doing great!
Good news! You guys are officially halfway through. Keep rippin shit my little murder buddies.
Ok that's enough killing for now. Call in the drop pod and get back up here.
Quota's been hit on the killing side, keep at it if you want but I suggest gettin out. You don't get overtime after all...
Well I would call that rampage a success, hope it was as theraputic as it looked from up here. Wipe off the mushroom guts and head on back.

Welcome to New Atlas… Bit of a dump now by the looks of it, and we gotta figure out why.
Facility up ahead should have some data that'll tell us where everybody got off to.
Uhh team, not to be all dramatic, but I'm seeing some weird looking signatures comin at ya.
HOLY SHIT, IS THAT A MICROWAVE?!
OH! And this one's a DISHWASHER... huh... It really has gotten into everything.

And- What the hell?! Even those parts you shot off are still showin signs of life. What a trip.
Alright, make sure you kill these guys DEAD. Those gooey centers should be the ticket, but if this is right then any parts you don't smash to a pulp might get picked up again.
Should be a vent in there that's still clear… Yeah you can fit in there… Oughta be fun.

Ooo an elevator shaft, a little indoor skydiving for ya. 
...See, this is why you send robots. If I did that? Flat as a pancake, no question. They'd probly bury me in a pizza box.
Ah! There's a terminal right up ahead. Now we're gettin somewhere.

Woah there! I'm getting a huge dump of… Somethin... I'm gonna toss this data to the nerds and see what they can dig up.
Until then, I'm scannin a big ass fungal growth out west. Better to get that clear before I pull you guys out... Y'know, since it's one those things in that pesky 'job description' they can't shut up about.

Woah, this computer shit can't be right. It says everything with wires kicked the bucket one day. And I mean *everything*. Toasters, phones, walkies, transmitters, heart monitors, all stopped reportin over one singular hour.
From the data it would make more sense if the whole rock got vaporized, but you're on er right now… And it's just… Overgrown…? How in the hell…

I've got you guys cleared to use some Blitsegs, these things are sweet.
Warp one down and you'll be across that sand in no time.
Now that's the sucker. Blast that thing to pieces and we'll be home free.

That's what we like to see, couldn'ta done it better myself.
Y'know, I don't think this extermination thing is gonna be too bad. Couple weeks, tops. Givin you guys grenades and shit was a bit over-kill...
Ok let's get you out of there. Hold your recall button (<>) to request the drop pod!

OH MY LORD! WHAT THE HELL IS EVEN THAT?!
Throw the grenades or somethin! We gotta GO!

HOH! You got em!
I'd like to say that was the only one but, ew... This stuff's all over...
Later problems though- problems for later... Good job.
Boy am I glad ya'll were armed. Get on back here and we'll gear ya up for another one, I think we got our work cut out for us…
I'm seeing a data deposit near your position. Probably a buncha useless numbers but I'm sure there's some extra cash in it for you if you get em out.
Couple of loaded hard drives with your name on it. Upload em and you'll net a nice bonus.
Data dump nearby has been flagged as important. Upload it to me and you'll earn yourself a bonus.
I'm losing connection! Stand inside the zone.
I know this is exciting but I need you guys inside the zone.
Quit hoppin around and get in the zone!
Upload complete! 2.2 terabytes of utter garbage, and a nice bonus for you.

That one was filled with the same picture copied literally millions of times... It's all just the same weird lookin bird...? ...Whatever, bonus is yours, and all those birds are off in cyberspace. God help us.
Upload done! Wow this one was actually company filings... Filings for a faster upload relay... What a recovery. Enjoy the bonus.
And uploaded! Oh I see... Cooking instructions for human bones, filed under "Honeymoon Plans," lovely. Glad you're getting paid for this.
Upload's all done. Just a bunch of numbers and shit again, thank god. Money's on the way.
Nice work. Already took a peak mid-upload, you do not want to know what this one was. Just take the money and buy yourself something nice.
Damnit, data's all corrupted. Best get back to your mission.
Data's all jumbled, nothing to do for it now. Gave it your best, but the mission takes priority.
Circuits got all gummed up, data's with the fungus now. Better luck next time.
I've got some fungal growths nearby that appear to be getting their roots in some underground machinery. Best to cut em off before they get any deeper, and you score yourself a bonus.
Fungus nearby is hitting some machinery of the load-bearing variety. Sweep it off real quick and Saxon'll toss in something extra.
Not a permanent fix, but there's some fungus nearby that's hitting major infrastructure. Blast it to bits and you will be paid handsomely.
That's the last of it! Sending your bonus over now.
Atomized that one I see. Good work and enjoy the bonus.
No trace of it left, amazing what you can get done with a little corporate incentive.
I've got a mineral-rich meteorite landing near your position. If you guys want a quick bonus, you can hurl some chunks of it back into orbit for collection.
Sensors are reading a pretty rare meteorite touching down in the area. I'll send a launcher and you can toss up its pieces for a bonus.
Mineral heavy meteor inbound. Once it lands you can blast it skyward and there's a bonus in it for you.

Just get those caps back on! Now!

It ain’t a dick! That set actually has some nice perks…
Anybody else hear that noise? It’s like a whining kinda thing-

Hey either ya got or ya don't lady.

DAMN Buddy you’ve been slammin Fusion Ash in there?

I am not! They said no already!

What?! Why’s it never sayin hello?
Hey stop it! I’m sorry, I don’t know why it’s acting like this-
Yeah, listen to your mama you little mushyyyy
Ooh the little guy’s got guts huh?!

…Does the dirt… Does the dirt taste any good?

Ooh, make sure you check that left fastening on your wing.

We should get out together more.

I think I'm starting to see the pattern here.

I made one of us out of wood once!
Well, at least it's a lot of me
Reminiscent of the old days a bit
Ulu 8, punched out 90% of my handlers teeth just before he put up a shield

english:
Since the wild-west craze ended, Wrangler has had a tough time landing an audition. Saxon immediately scooped him up upon realizing he could do a triple backflip like it was nothing. Still hopeful for his next big break, he does his best to spin his stunt skills towards actual combat, complete with a lasso and healthy amount of southern charm.



<size=20>COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 2/5
thai:
ตั้งแต่กระแสคาวบอยตะวันตกซาลง Wrangler ก็หางานแสดงแทบไม่ได้ Saxon รีบคว้าตัวเขาทันทีที่รู้ว่าเขาตีลังกาหลังสามรอบได้สบายๆ เขายังหวังจะได้แจ้งเกิดครั้งใหญ่ เลยพยายามเอาทักษะสตันต์มาใช้ในการต่อสู้จริง พร้อมบ่วงบาศกับเสน่ห์หนุ่มบ้านนาเต็มพิกัด



<size=20>คะแนนวัฒนธรรมองค์กร: 2/5

english:
Retired as an automated security robot and given sentience, Bruiser was awoken with the worst hangover imaginable. Upon taking their first look around, Bruiser knocked nearly every tooth out of their superiors mouth with a single punch, and was escorted out of the building. What followed was a series of gambling, drinking, fights, and other bad decisions that eventually landed them here.



<size=20>COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 1/5
thai:
เดิมเป็นหุ่นรักษาความปลอดภัยอัตโนมัติที่ปลดระวางแล้วได้รับสติสัมปชัญญะ Bruiser ตื่นขึ้นมาพร้อมอาการแฮงก์หนักที่สุดเท่าที่จะนึกออก พอมองไปรอบตัวครั้งแรก Bruiser ก็ต่อยหัวหน้าหมัดเดียวฟันร่วงเกือบหมดปาก แล้วโดนหิ้วออกจากตึก หลังจากนั้นก็มีทั้งพนัน กินเหล้า ต่อยตี และการตัดสินใจแย่ๆ อีกเพียบ จนสุดท้ายมาลงเอยที่นี่



<size=20>คะแนนวัฒนธรรมองค์กร: 1/5

english:
Accidentally left to rust on a Saxon dumping planet, Scrapper built herself up from the scraps others left behind. Over countless years she honed her skills and improved herself. One fateful day she hijacked a dumping ship and threatened to crash it into something important if her demands weren’t met. Not wanting to waste such an interesting asset, Saxon offered her a job instead.



<size=20>COMPANY CULTURE RATING: N/A
thai:
Scrapper ถูกทิ้งให้ขึ้นสนิมบนดาวทิ้งขยะของ Saxon โดยไม่ตั้งใจ เธอประกอบตัวเองขึ้นมาจากเศษซากที่คนอื่นทิ้งไว้ ฝึกฝีมือและอัปเกรดตัวเองมานับปีไม่ถ้วน จนวันหนึ่งเธอจี้ยานขนขยะแล้วขู่ว่าจะเอาไปชนอะไรสำคัญๆ ถ้าไม่ทำตามข้อเรียกร้อง Saxon ไม่อยากเสียของดีแบบนี้ไป เลยเสนองานให้เธอแทน



<size=20>คะแนนวัฒนธรรมองค์กร: N/A

english:
Formerly a member of the Galactic Safety Commission, Glider was built and trained as a search and rescue drone. Being a drone, she was programmed with limited mental faculties, and her memories were strictly proprietary. Saxon offered to remove these restrictions if she defect and join their expedition. Unbeknownst to her, this allows Saxon to automatically pass GSC inspections.



<size=20>COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 3/5
thai:
อดีตสมาชิกของ Galactic Safety Commission, Glider ถูกสร้างและฝึกมาเป็นโดรนค้นหาและกู้ภัย ในฐานะโดรน เธอถูกโปรแกรมให้คิดได้จำกัด และความทรงจำของเธอก็เป็นลิขสิทธิ์ของบริษัท Saxon เสนอจะปลดข้อจำกัดพวกนี้ให้ถ้าเธอยอมแปรพักตร์มาร่วมการสำรวจ โดยที่เธอไม่รู้เลยว่านี่ทำให้ Saxon ผ่านการตรวจของ GSC ได้อัตโนมัติ



<size=20>คะแนนวัฒนธรรมองค์กร: 3/5

english:
The sole survivor of Expedition Alpha, the first team sent to investigate New Atlas' fungal outbreak. For unknown reasons, she is now fused with a new strain of the fungus that is much friendlier, and quite content with coming along for the ride.

<size=20>COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 3/5 | -1/5
thai:
ผู้รอดชีวิตคนเดียวของ Expedition Alpha ทีมแรกที่ถูกส่งไปตรวจสอบการระบาดของเชื้อราบน New Atlas ด้วยเหตุผลที่ไม่มีใครรู้ ตอนนี้เธอหลอมรวมกับเชื้อราสายพันธุ์ใหม่ที่เป็นมิตรกว่ามาก และมันก็ดูแฮปปี้ดีที่ได้ติดสอยห้อยตามไปด้วย

english: I've seen this before you know... Dark times...
Y'all should really switch to wheels, pedaling around on those little legs looks horrible. And when you get got, they fly off like pew-
I've noticed some of em got little bombs strapped on em. You think they just had a buncha bombs lying around?
Bastards grabbed one of my spark plugs. Or... Hey wait! What've you got in your pocket there cadet!?
There goes that... Right in the grass, perfect.
Hah HA! Did I getcha there? Anyways, let's get a move on!
Hello crew, let's give these bastards hell all the way there!
Oh my wheels ain't whut they used to be, guard my sides cadets!
Why you're a colorful group of cadets... Shall we haul this to the end?
Bastards clipped me! Get that wheel repaired!
Ooh! I'm hit! Get a wrench over here one of yous!
That one smarts... Need a hand... Please...
I could roll better on a square! Get this thing fixed!
WOOAAHOOO NELLY! That's done and buried there!
That STINGS! It's like you guys have fish for guns... Keep em off me!
WEEeew! No better feeling... Thanks cadet!
Fit as a fiddle! Thank you there... but get back to it! No time to sit around.
You really know your way around that wrench! Love to see it!
Good as new, if not a little better, thanks cadet!
Next time don't let it get so bent!
Why's Hunk taking so long? What's the hold up? MY TIRES ARE OUT AND I DON'T HAVE ARMS! COME FIX ME!!
There goes another one, no it's no problem, that's just what happens when NO ONE FIXES YOUR WHEELS!
I know you all got some wrenches! I'd say it's high time to use em!
Someone should break all of your legs and just... leave em like that for a while. Oh nooo, but that's too mean. Who would ever do something like thaaaat...
Hah! Oh I'm sorry, just seein your little body just- just how it-
Hoh! Damn! Careful there cadet, I can't see you down there.
And that's another one! Just try and be anywhere but there, I'm begging you here.
My fault! That one's on me I shoulda warned you. But keep your eyes up lad I got a lot goin on here!
Halfway there! If you're already having trouble... Haha we got a loooot more to go! ...But also hop on, it's safer up here.
Halfway mark! If you packed a sandwich, suck er down now!
And there it is... Halfway lads!
Halfway! Would be an excellent milestone if there weren't so many damn things crawling all over.
There’s oil at that depot, lads! Just a little further!
Ooo I can almost smell it! Keep those triggers pressed lads, we're almost there!
Home free! Great workin with ya cadets, get back safe ya hear!!
Loved your bombs and bullets but I gotta split. Hunk signin off.
Keep givin em hell for me cadets! I'll see you in the next one!

OOHHHHH SHIT! I'm the wrong way round!
Even ol' Hunk gets it twisted sometimes!
SHIT! I am backwards cadets... Let's just get this turned around...
WOAH! You may notice that I'm facing the wrong way... pay it no mind.
Howdy do there little bot, where can an old rust bucket like me get some wings like those?
The Galactic Safety Comission! I think they-

The FEDS?!
Aw HELL no I am NOT tangling with them again!
Hey truck, you're a Saxon Type 78 Hauler Unit right?
You sure know your history cadet, I'm impressed.

Blast proof plating, rad seal lining, and a reactor that won't quit.
I wanna make armor out of you old timer.
If we make it through this... I'll will you my corpse!
I need a damn drink... This treck is warin on me.
Pour some in my tank if you got it cadet, the harder the better.
Hold it there pal, you know what they say about drinkin on the road.

Does it look like I got any other options?!
Yeah you're right, I'll just park my ass in one place for the next few hours!
You there, cadet. Do one of those dive slams on my back, lower section to be specific.
Of course the truck is a weirdo too...
No please! You don't understand! I haven't met anyone capable of cracking my back in fifty years!
I am not a cheap replacement for your long lost jack hammer you wheeled baby.

YAAAAAAAAOOOOOOEEWHOOOOOOOIEEE!
Bless your soul cadet I feel GREAT!

With the Hashetty attempting to gain ground on Saxon solar systems, I have had numerous additional opportunities to observe Psions and their capabilities. As the Psion had not used a similar power in the engagement, this is assumed to be a side effect of the deflection.
If I were to theorize what this phenomenon is, I may hazard to guess that it has something to do with willpower. Until now we assumed that all Psions shared personality traits simply because that is what was rewarded in Hashetty society, it is possible that their brazen zealotry is *necessary* to using Psionics.
Psions emerge themselves in a torrent of power, and during that time a single shade of doubt, a tiny crack in one’s will and reality rushes in to drown them out.

[Excerpt from the personal notes of Dr. Ilma Juste]
While I have not had extensive time to surgically explore the bodies of these Hashetty Psions, cursory investigation seems to reveal a net zero of what distinguishes a Psion from a normal Hashet, beyond all the jewelry. We have not been able to capture one alive, nor do I ever see that happening. A Psion is the closest I have ever seen to a walking bomb.
Psionics imbue the wielder with near arcane power, one I can only describe as wholly supernatural, a chaos that tears the edges of reality, then knits them back together as the will of the caster sees fit. The applications of such power are incredibly varied, and strangely limited, but seem to fall into the two general categories of mental and spatial control. Control over heat, electricity, and other forms of energy seem totally beyond reach, a Psion could never light a candle but can somehow implant a thought into a mind that is nothing but circuits.
I am tempted to theorize that Psionics allow the user to directly rewrite reality itself, a simple decision, dictating that a man’s atoms are no longer connected [See: The Disintegration of Admiral Fetters], or that a planet’s materials should be organized alphabetically from top to bottom [See: The Destruction of Hazaran].
My instincts tell me that there is no sane way to view this power, so I will stop trying.

english:
Hazard crews of New Atlas,
This is a notice that the rewards for Sample Collection have been suspended, effective immediately.

To those that participated:
Our floral research team thanks you heartily for the high yield of samples you collected, and are now hard at work analyzing them.
Saxon would also like to thank you personally, [<>], for aiding in Sample Collection, and furthering the progress towards a cleaner New Atlas. We look forward to your continued cooperation and enthusiasm.

To those that did not participate:
- Company Culture Rating - Lowered by 0.8 Points
- Prior “Team Player” Badges Removed
- Badge “Poor Sport” Added
Did you know that participating employees made 500% more than non-participating employees on average? 

Additionally, the Floral team has asked us to include some notes from their initial analysis. This [OPTIONAL MATERIAL] has been attached below.




Hey guys!

Thank you so much for getting all the samples in to us! (The bullet casings weren’t a problem at all). I didn’t think we’d be talking so soon (Kemp says hey), but we’re the Floral team a couple planets over.

We’re still working on sorting everything out (it tries to stab us whenever we accidentally leave syringes out, so things have been slow) but we’ve got some initial tidbits we wanted to give you guys:

First of all - It’s everybody…
We have found that the fungus is actually way more dangerous to biological material than it is to machinery. If you haven’t seen a ton of corpses, that’s why. From cursory scanning we have found trace evidence of ~8 different people per sample. This sucks a bunch.
Good news is! You guys are all robots! It can take over technology (clearly), but it seems much slower than how it consumes/infects biological material. So just make sure you wash off the spores here and there. (We have been told you have something shower-adjacent)

Secondly - It’s mostly dormant!
We’re all still alive over here! Seems like the fungus has slowed down a bit since taking over the planet, totally unsure why. Could be spread too thin, needs to feed some more, who knows. It appears fully sentient, especially with the way it’s using weapons against you guys. Just make sure to keep an eye out down there, we have no idea how crafty this stuff is.

- The Floral Team
thai:
ถึงทีมเสี่ยงภัยแห่ง New Atlas
ขอแจ้งว่ารางวัลของกิจกรรมเก็บตัวอย่างถูกระงับแล้ว มีผลทันที

ถึงผู้ที่เข้าร่วม:
ทีมวิจัยพฤกษศาสตร์ของเราขอขอบคุณจากใจสำหรับตัวอย่างจำนวนมหาศาลที่พวกคุณเก็บมา ตอนนี้พวกเขากำลังวิเคราะห์กันอย่างขะมักเขม้น
Saxon ขอขอบคุณคุณเป็นการส่วนตัวด้วย [<>] ที่ช่วยเก็บตัวอย่าง และผลักดันให้ New Atlas สะอาดขึ้น เราหวังว่าจะได้รับความร่วมมือและความกระตือรือร้นจากคุณต่อไป

ถึงผู้ที่ไม่ได้เข้าร่วม:
- คะแนนวัฒนธรรมองค์กร - ลดลง 0.8 แต้ม
- ถอดเหรียญ “ทีมเพลเยอร์” ที่เคยได้
- เพิ่มเหรียญ “ขี้แพ้ชวนตี”
รู้ไหมว่าพนักงานที่เข้าร่วมได้เงินมากกว่าคนที่ไม่เข้าร่วมเฉลี่ย 500%? 

นอกจากนี้ ทีมพฤกษศาสตร์ขอให้เราแนบบันทึกจากการวิเคราะห์เบื้องต้นมาด้วย [OPTIONAL MATERIAL] นี้แนบอยู่ด้านล่าง




หวัดดีทุกคน!

ขอบคุณมากที่ส่งตัวอย่างมาให้ครบ! (ปลอกกระสุนที่ติดมาด้วยไม่เป็นปัญหาเลย) ไม่คิดว่าจะได้คุยกันเร็วขนาดนี้ (Kemp ฝากทักทาย) พวกเราคือทีมพฤกษศาสตร์อยู่ห่างไปไม่กี่ดาว

เรายังจัดการทุกอย่างไม่เสร็จ (มันพยายามแทงพวกเราทุกทีที่เผลอวางเข็มฉีดยาทิ้งไว้ งานเลยช้าหน่อย) แต่ได้ข้อมูลเบื้องต้นมาบอกพวกคุณนิดหน่อย:

ข้อแรก - มันคือทุกคน…
เราพบว่าเชื้อราอันตรายต่อสิ่งมีชีวิตมากกว่าเครื่องจักรเยอะ ถ้าพวกคุณไม่ค่อยเห็นศพ นั่นแหละเหตุผล จากการสแกนคร่าวๆ เราเจอร่องรอยของคนราว ~8 คนต่อหนึ่งตัวอย่าง แย่สุดๆ
ข่าวดีคือ! พวกคุณเป็นหุ่นยนต์กันหมด! มันยึดเทคโนโลยีได้ (เห็นๆ อยู่) แต่ดูช้ากว่าตอนกินหรือติดเชื้อสิ่งมีชีวิตมาก งั้นก็แค่ล้างสปอร์ออกบ้างเป็นระยะ (ได้ยินมาว่าพวกคุณมีอะไรที่ใกล้เคียงฝักบัวอยู่)

ข้อสอง - มันส่วนใหญ่จำศีลอยู่!
พวกเราทางนี้ยังรอดกันอยู่! ดูเหมือนเชื้อราจะช้าลงหลังยึดดาวได้ ไม่รู้เหมือนกันว่าทำไม อาจกระจายตัวบางเกิน ต้องหาอาหารเพิ่ม ใครจะไปรู้ มันดูมีสติเต็มที่ โดยเฉพาะวิธีที่มันใช้อาวุธสู้พวกคุณ ระวังตัวไว้ด้วยนะข้างล่างนั่น เราไม่รู้เลยว่าของพวกนี้เจ้าเล่ห์แค่ไหน

- ทีมพฤกษศาสตร์
